fact: Expertise France's project page, published 2026-02-17, says its EU-funded project (running August 2024 to August 2027) works with ESTDEV to improve and align Botswana's National Interoperability framework, standards, guidelines and tools, and lists a 'harmonised and operational national interoperability framework for e-government services' as an expected result; the page does not say the framework has been adopted or issued, and its date is the page's published date.

Section 12 of the Digital Services Act, 2025 (No. 22, assented 2025-10-17, commencement by Ministerial Order) requires the Digital Services Authority to establish a standardised Framework for Secure Exchange of Information ensuring secure communication, identity verification, data integrity and interoperability; the Act does not say the framework has been issued, and its date is the assent date.
